name: standalone value shrinkers
mechanism: given a plain value and a Boolean property, repeatedly propose type-specific smaller values (zero, one, bit masks, shifts, subtractions; sorted regions; chunk deletions) under greedy acceptance until no move improves

sources.ref: RECEIPT_N1 P-a1..a3 run with no engine

requires: flat sequence of orderable elements or a non-negative integer
fails_when: nested/tree values are not accepted (type A transfer failure)
